definitionZh: QVideo Vue 组件使嵌入 Youtube 等视频变得容易。默认情况下，它还会调整大小以适合容器。
sourceDefinition: The QVideo Vue components makes embedding a video like Youtube easy. It also resizes to fit the container by default.
